issues.display_title: Issue #1: Fixing Strange Shape and Black Color of Image
issues.main_description_html:
Link :
https://tourmkr.com/F15CwDnzRu

QA Summary - 2026-07-24

Verdict: PASS - expected behavior confirmed; target tour is inaccessible in VR because VR is disabled in the user's tour settings
Tester: Codex + manual real-device VR validation
Environment: Real VR device manual recording, Windows desktop source/API review
Target Real Data: https://tourmkr.com/F15CwDnzRu / F15CwDnzRu / Boca da Onca Ecotour
Developer Confirmation: Developer confirmed this is caused by user-side VR settings being disabled, not API/BE/FE/app coding.

Manual Real Device Summary

Step Input Observed Result QA Result
Tour Key search F15CwDnzRu VR app shows Tourkey not found. BLOCKED
All Tours text search Boca da Onca Ecotour VR app shows Data not found. BLOCKED
Image hotspot validation Target issue tour Could not reach the tour or issue image hotspot in VR. Not executed

Root Cause Summary

Area Finding Result
User/tour setting Developer confirmed the tour has VR access disabled in settings. NOT A BUG
API/BE No BE bug is confirmed for this issue after developer clarification. NOT A BUG
FE/app search No FE/app coding bug is confirmed; the app cannot access a VR-disabled tour. NOT A BUG
HTTP 500 check No HTTP 500 was observed in tested calls. PASS

Code Review Summary

Area File Finding Coding Bug? Result
Tour key search flow Assets/Source/Src/Script/Tour/PanoramaController.cs Search flow calls WebRequestManager.GetTourByKey() and handles not-found response. No PASS/INFO
API URL construction Assets/Source/Src/Script/Main/WebRequestManager.cs GetTourByKey() builds the expected /tours?account=&tour_key={key}&tour_name=&limit=1&page=1 request. No PASS/INFO
All Tours search flow Assets/Source/Src/Script/UI/MainMenu/Board/Content/Alltours.cs Search flow passes the entered text to GetTours(..., tourName, ...). No PASS/INFO

Test Method Summary

Method Coverage Result Notes
White box Reviewed VR search path and request construction. PASS/INFO No app-side search coding bug confirmed.
Gray box Matched manual VR behavior with developer-confirmed VR-disabled setting. NOT A BUG Inaccessibility is expected for a VR-disabled tour.
Black box Manual real-device VR video. BLOCKED/EXPECTED User could not find target tour because VR access is disabled.
Confusion matrix QA outcome mapping. Applicable as not-a-bug matrix One issue-level suspected bug was reclassified as not a bug.

Confusion Matrix

Actual / Predicted Predicted Bug Predicted Not Bug
Actual Bug 0 0
Actual Not Bug 0 1

Evidence

Evidence Artifact
Real-device VR video, manual test
issue-1-manual-vr-search-not-found-20260724.mp4

Notes for Developer

  • This is not a coding bug. Developer confirmed the tour cannot be accessed in VR because VR is disabled in the user's tour settings.
  • No API/BE/FE bug is confirmed from this test.
  • No HTTP 500 was observed.
  • Re-test image hotspot only after VR is enabled for the target tour or a VR-enabled equivalent tour is provided.

issues.display_title: Issue #2: Integrate get tours by email
issues.main_description_html:
New API get tours
Route : {{base_url}}/tours?account=...&page=...&limit=..

QA Summary - 2026-07-24

Verdict: PASS - get tours by email is integrated and works with real API data in VR
Tester: Codex + manual real-device VR validation
Environment: Real VR device manual recording, Windows desktop API/source review
Real Data Accounts: testergothru@gmail.com, testpanorra@gmail.com, not-a-real-account-for-qa@example.com

Manual Real Device Summary

Step Input Observed Result QA Result
My Tours valid account Saved/entered account with 44 tours VR My Tours screen shows Total tours(44) and paginated tour cards. PASS
Pagination My Tours list page controls Page 1 and page 2 display tour cards without crash/freeze. PASS
My Tours second account/data set Account with 35 visible tours in recording VR My Tours screen shows Total tours(35) and tour cards. PASS
Error/500 check Manual VR flow No visible crash, freeze, or HTTP 500 symptom in the recording. PASS

API / Real Data Summary

Check Request Response Result
Primary valid account GET https://apil.gothru.co/api/tours?account=testergothru@gmail.com&page=1&limit=5 200 OK, pagination.totals=44, 5 tour rows returned PASS
Secondary valid account GET https://apil.gothru.co/api/tours?account=testpanorra@gmail.com&page=1&limit=5 200 OK, pagination.totals=3, 3 tour rows returned PASS
Invalid account GET https://apil.gothru.co/api/tours?account=not-a-real-account-for-qa@example.com&page=1&limit=5 200 OK, body statusCode=404, messages.validation.user_not_found PASS with caveat
HTTP 500 check Same tested endpoints No 500 observed PASS

Code Review Summary

Area File Finding Coding Bug? Result
Shared API route Assets/Source/Src/Script/Main/WebRequestManager.cs GetTours() builds https://apil.gothru.co/api/tours?account={account}&tour_key=&tour_name={tourName}&limit={limit}&page={page}. No PASS
My Tours UI Assets/Source/Src/Script/UI/MainMenu/Board/Content/MyTours/MyTours.cs Reads inputEmail.text, calls WebRequestManager.instance.GetTours(...), stores pagination.totals, and renders returned tour cards. No PASS
Room My Tours figures Assets/Source/Src/Script/Room/Room.cs Reads saved emailMyTours and calls GetTours(..., email, "", "1", "5", ...) for room figures. No PASS
Invalid account behavior WebRequestManager.cs / API contract API returns HTTP 200 with JSON body statusCode=404; no app-side coding bug is confirmed from this issue. No INFO

Test Method Summary

Method Coverage Result Notes
White box Reviewed shared request wrapper, My Tours UI, and Room My Tours figure code. PASS App-side integration uses the requested account, page, and limit API shape.
Gray box Matched VR My Tours totals/cards with live API responses. PASS Real API returns successful data for known accounts and the VR list renders account-based tours.
Black box Manual real-device VR video. PASS User-visible My Tours list and pagination work on device.
Confusion matrix QA outcome mapping. Applicable as pass matrix One issue-level expected pass was observed as pass.

Confusion Matrix

Actual / Predicted Predicted Pass Predicted Fail
Actual Pass 1 0
Actual Fail 0 0

Evidence

Evidence Artifact
Real-device VR video, manual test
issue-2-manual-vr-get-tours-by-email-20260724.mp4

Notes for Developer

  • No destructive real-data mutation was performed.
  • No HTTP 500 was observed.
  • No app-side coding bug is confirmed from this issue.
  • Invalid account still returns HTTP 200 with a JSON statusCode=404; this is noted as an API-contract caveat only, not a blocking app bug for this task.

Installation Unity 6 : https://unity.com/releases/editor/whats-new/6000.0.0

QA Summary - 2026-07-24

Verdict: FAIL / BLOCKED - Unity 6 installation/migration is not confirmed in the repo config; real-device VR smoke still runs
Tester: Codex + manual real-device VR validation
Environment: Real VR device manual recording, Windows desktop source/config review
Issue Scope: Download and installation Unity 6 / project compatibility with Unity 6

Manual Real Device Summary

Step Observed Result QA Result
App launch / room view VR app opens and shows the room scene. PASS
Main menu access Main menu/sidebar can be opened and navigated. PASS
My Tours UI smoke My Tours UI opens, email/search fields can be interacted with, and list content is visible. PASS
Crash/freeze check No crash or freeze visible in the supplied real-device video. PASS
Unity 6 install/build verification Video does not show Unity Editor 6, package import, or Android build output. BLOCKED

Source / Config Review Summary

Area File Finding Coding Bug? Result
Unity editor version ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt Current repo config is 2022.3.62f3, not Unity 6 / 6000.x. No, config/migration blocker FAIL
Android package version ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset App version remains bundleVersion=1.10.12, AndroidBundleVersionCode=53. No INFO
Android app id ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset Android identifier remains com.gothru.gothrunavigatorvr. No PASS
XR/Oculus packages Packages/manifest.json com.unity.xr.management=4.5.0 and com.unity.xr.oculus=4.5.1 are present. No PASS
Oculus XR settings Assets/XR/Settings/OculusSettings.asset / Assets/XR/Loaders/OculusLoader.asset Oculus loader/settings assets are present for Android XR. No PASS

Test Method Summary

Method Coverage Result Notes
White box Reviewed Unity project version, Android settings, and XR/Oculus config. FAIL/BLOCKED Project is still pinned to Unity 2022.3.62f3, so Unity 6 installation/migration is not confirmed.
Gray box Matched project config with supplied real-device runtime video. BLOCKED Runtime smoke passes, but video does not prove the app was built/imported with Unity 6.
Black box Manual real-device VR smoke video. PASS for runtime smoke only App opens and UI is usable on device.
